nodes.title: Mass growth allowance by maturity
nodes.text: Growth added to each item's basic mass by how it was obtained: EST 20 %, CALC 10 %, DATASHEET 5 %, CAD 5 %, WEIGHED 1 %. An item may override (the pack carries 24 % to reach the 680 g listing).
nodes.basis: Maturity-based allowance after AIAA S-120A (mass properties control); percentages are A3's choice for a student foam build, ESTIMATE

nodes.title: Pack fore-aft trim travel
nodes.text: The pack can be strapped anywhere within +/- this distance of its nominal station without re-building the pod
nodes.basis: params.json pod.x_le_m note: D2 provides +/-0.03 m

nodes.title: Hover pitch-trim thrust split limit
nodes.text: Upper/lower motor-pair thrust ratio needed to trim the CG z offset in hover stays <= 1.10, so at most ~5 % of each pair's hover thrust is spent on trim and the rest stays available for control
nodes.basis: A3 choice pending B3/F4 hover-authority analysis; at T/W 2.4 the pairs run at ~41 % of max

nodes.title: Pack mass range from listings
Mass roll-up against allocations and the gate
nodes.equation: basic = sum m_i ; predicted = sum m_i (1 + MGA_i) ; margin = gate - predicted ; overrun_s = basic_s - alloc_s

nodes.title: CG cases, pack station for the target, hover trim split
nodes.equation: cg = sum m_i r_i / sum m_i ; x_pack_req = (x_t M - (M x_cg - m_p x_p)) / m_p ; split = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg) ; h_stance = c - x_cg + foot ; range_use = |x - mid| / half-range ; shift_req(group) = (x_t - x_cg) M / m_group

nodes.title: Inertia tensor about the CG (aircraft frame)
nodes.equation: I = sum m_i (|r_i|^2 E - r_i r_i^T) + box self-inertia m/12 (b^2 + c^2) ; r_i from the CG

nodes.title: Take-off mass, basic estimate (no growth)
nodes.how: Re-run mass_rollup.py on the parts.csv files; weigh the assembled aircraft with pack (T-A1-WEIGH).

nodes.title: Take-off mass, predicted (basic + growth by maturity)
nodes.how: Same roll-up; growth shrinks as items move EST -> CAD -> WEIGHED. Weigh every bought part on arrival.

nodes.title: Gate margin after growth covers the first-build overrun
nodes.how: 2.6 kg minus the predicted mass must stay >= the 0.10 kg first-build overrun; weigh the first core and fin.

nodes.title: Worst subsystem basic mass / its A1 allocation
nodes.how: ROLLUP.md subsystem table; A1 re-allocates through CR-A3-01.

nodes.title: CG x at take-off, current layout
nodes.how: Balance on two knife edges under the spar line (T-A3-CG-BALANCE).

nodes.title: CG x position in the allowable range, |x - mid| / half-range
nodes.how: CG balance with pack at its station; B3 confirms the range from AVL.

nodes.title: Pack centroid station that puts the CG on target
nodes.how: Strap the pack at this x and balance (T-A3-CG-BALANCE); D2 places the pod around it.

nodes.title: Pack at the required station still ends ahead of the TE
nodes.how: D2 pod drawing: pack aft face x <= wing TE.

nodes.title: CG z position in the allowable range, |z - mid| / half-range
nodes.how: Balance the aircraft on its side (z axis vertical) on a knife edge.

nodes.title: Hover pitch-trim thrust split upper/lower
nodes.how: Tethered hover log: mean upper vs lower motor outputs (F4/H2).

nodes.title: CG balance
nodes.procedure: Two knife edges (or two scales) under the wing at known x; ready to fly, props on.

nodes.title: Bifilar pendulum inertia
nodes.procedure: Two 1.5 m strings, 0.30 m apart, about each axis; I = m g d^2 T^2 / (16 pi^2 L).
